maddeler.t: By surface analysis, نَحْلَة الْعَسَلِ (naḥla(t) al-ʕasali, “honeybee”) + إِفْرِيقِيّ (ʔifrīqiyy, “African”)
s: By surface analysis, نَحْلَة الْعَسَلِ (naḥla(t) al-ʕasali, “honeybee”) + إِفْرِيقِيّ (ʔifrīqiyy, “African”)
